We are studying meaningful evaluation metrics for the qualities of dialogs.

Specifically, you'll be given two pieces of dialogs, and you'll be asked to compare which dialog is better, and write down your rationales in free-text.

Guidelines:
  1. First, choose which dialog is better. There are four choices: Definitely A/B and Slightly A/B .
    • Please trust your instincts and choose Definitely if you would feel more confident giving one dialog, versus the other one.
    • Try to focus on quality over quantity. Contentful/high-quality dialog doesn't need to be lengthy.
  2. Second, please describe in detail your option for Quetion 1.
    • It would be helpful to describe both reasons you like the better dialog and reasons why you did not like the other dialog.
    • Please be specific and detailed in your rationale.
Note:
  • Please do not work on these HITs if you work at the University of Washington.
Dialog A
Hey, I saw that you're going to Paris next week. I've always wanted to go there too!
Yeah, I'm really excited. It's going to be a great trip.
I would love to come with you if you don't mind. I have always dreamed of seeing the Eiffel Tower and exploring the city.
That sounds great! I would love to have you come along.
Thank you so much! I'm really excited to go with you.
So, have you ever been to France before?
No, I haven't. But I've always wanted to go. The language and culture are really interesting to me.
Yeah, it's a great place. I'm sure you'll love it.
I can't wait to see the Eiffel Tower. It's been on my bucket list for a long time.
It's definitely a sight to see. You'll love it.
Dialog B
Excuse me , sir , Is this the road to the peace Store ?
You could get there this way , but it'd be faster to go along the Wort Street .
Where's Wort Street , please ?
Turn right at the third intersection , you'll see the street and then walk along the street to the south .
How far is it from the Wort Street ?
Just walk for a few minutes , you'll find it .
